memoryStorage.title: Memory storage
memoryStorage.description: Where long-term memory (Lance datasets) lives. What is supported follows Lance's build features: a local directory, S3-compatible (AWS / MinIO / RustFS / COS in S3 mode), and Alibaba Cloud OSS.
memoryStorage.locationLocalHint: Absolute path of a local directory, e.g. D:/shadow/memory.
memoryStorage.endpointHint: For a self-hosted MinIO / RustFS or a non-default region. Required for OSS (e.g. https://oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com).
memoryStorage.secretHint: Shown as *** when configured (saving it unchanged keeps the stored value). Keys are sealed in the brain's credential store.
memoryStorage.allowHttp: Allow an HTTP endpoint (self-hosted object store on the LAN)
memoryStorage.copyIfNotExistsHint: Optional. RustFS supports header: if-none-match: *; plain AWS S3 does not — leave it empty.
memoryStorage.savedPendingRestart: Saved — takes effect after the brain restarts.
memoryStorage.unreadableHint: This is not "nothing configured": the control plane is not connected. Reason: {{reason}}. Make sure the brain is running and its control plane is available (the desktop uses a local one by default).
memoryStorage.invalidLocation: The location cannot be empty (S3/OSS need a bucket).
memoryStorage.pendingRestartHint: ⚠️ The storage location is read once at boot — saving takes effect only after the brain restarts.
memoryStorage.priorityHint: Priority: control plane (here) → host-provided directory → environment → platform default.
memoryStorage.migrationHint: Changing the location **migrates** the existing memories: chat and memory operations pause while it runs, and the app must stay open until it finishes.

migration.title: Migrating the memory store
migration.runningHint: Moving memories, conversations and graph data to the new location. Please don't use the app; if it is closed mid-way, the migration resumes next time.
migration.failedHint: The migration did not finish. Your existing data is untouched — retry or abort.
migration.doneHint: Migration complete — restarting the app so the new location takes effect.
migration.cleanupWarn: The new location is ready, but some files in the old location could not be removed (harmless):
migration.abort: Abort and keep the old store

memoryStorage.defaultRootHint: Leave empty to use the default location: {{path}} (next to the executable; an existing legacy location is kept)
